name: Zapier
description: Zapier is a no-code automation platform that connects thousands of business apps, and increasingly AI models and agents, so users can build automated workflows without writing code.
best_for: Positioned for organizations of all sizes — from small/medium businesses to enterprise IT — that want teams to build automations while giving IT centralized governance.
features: Automated workflows (Zaps) across thousands of connected apps
Zapier Tables for lightweight data storage
Governance and security controls for enterprise use

alternatives.name: Make
alternatives.description: A visual automation platform where users build multi-step workflows connecting apps and AI models on a drag-and-drop canvas.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a more visual, flowchart-style automation builder

alternatives.name: n8n
alternatives.description: A workflow automation platform for technical users, combining a visual canvas with custom code and self-hosting options.
alternatives.best_for: Technical teams that want full visibility and control, including self-hosting
